scene.source: real SWOT L2 LR SSH Expert (Version D) + OSCAR L4 currents, Arabian Sea, 55-75E/0-25N, 2024-05-17 to 2024-08-17 (refreshed from whatever local granules were present at run time)
scene.note: Irregular real revisit cadence, not fixed-daily: SWOT passes 1-5.5 days apart.

detection.note: No ground truth exists for real satellite data (unlike the synthetic scene), so this is a count, not an accuracy score against a known answer.

forecast.note: No ground-truth future position exists for real data either, so error can't be scored directly; confidence/fit_r2 are reported instead as the model's own self-assessment of forecast reliability.

real_world_cross_check.method: closed-contour SSH identification (Chelton/Mason-style, same family as AVISO's published eddy atlas and py-eddy-tracker), run independently on this project's own real SWOT/OSCAR field
real_world_cross_check.note: "Agreeing" means the independent contour method places an eddy of the same rotation sign within max_match_km of ours in the same snapshot. Not a claim either method is ground truth -- evidence our detections correspond to real SSH structure a standard, independently implemented method also finds, not artifacts of the topological method alone.

rl.note: RL retraining on recalibrated real-world speeds still running.
